summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its operating partnership and subsidiary co-issuers issued $150.0 million of additional 7.375% unsecured senior notes due September 30, 2030, under a supplemental indenture dated September 17, 2026, tacking onto an October 6, 2025 base indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee. The notes were placed privately under Rule 144A and Regulation S, are fully guaranteed by the parent, pay semi-annual interest each March 31 and September 30, and are expected to fund general corporate purposes, including repaying repo borrowings. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
